lines: Whispers through the night, in shadows held,
Echoes of forgotten tales untold.
Beneath the moon, where secrets dwell,
Silent hands upon the ancient wall.

in the hollows where secrets hide

ancient trees hold hands with the stars
whispering tales of forgotten lands

the forest sighs in hushed delight.

in dreams of dawn, they shall take flight.
